summary: UX_UI_IMPLEMENTATION_9_FINAL_VALIDATION — frontend-only. Verified fix: Onboarding completion screen now shows EXACTLY 3 recommendations for FREE users, all accessible, pulling from the role's free-situation list. Tested at 390x800 for both Bartender and Waiter free flows. Also ran code review + regression smoke + i18n checks.

issues: Recommendation titles mix languages when free list is filled via getSituation fallback: the API's top-level `title` field is the backend default (English for recommending-drinks, welcoming-guests, bringing-the-bill) while existing recs returned with localized titles (es for taking-a-drinks-order etc.). Non-blocking — titles are non-empty as required — but UX inconsistency. Fix: use getLocalizedField(x, 'title', language) when mapping the fallback situations in Onboarding.js showRecommendations (lines ~198-199).

action_items: (Minor i18n polish) In Onboarding.js showRecommendations fallback mapping, localize title/description via getLocalizedField(x, 'title', language) / getLocalizedField(x, 'description', language) instead of using x.title and x.translations?.en?.description, so free-filler recs render in the user's selected UI language.
critical_code_review_comments: Onboarding.js:194 Premium path uses list.slice(0,3) when billing.ready && billing.isPremium('hospitality'). Confirmed per spec.

Onboarding.js:195-200 Free path: filters existing recs by isFreeSituation(slug,'hospitality', role), then fills missing with freeSlugs('hospitality', role) in FREE_SITUATIONS_BY_ROLE order, excluding duplicates. Correct.
Onboarding.js:199 fallback mapping uses x.title (default lang) and translations?.en?.description — should use getLocalizedField for consistent i18n.
accessConfig.js correctly exposes FREE_SITUATIONS_BY_ROLE for bartender & waiter with 5 slugs each; freeSlugs(role) returns Set preserving insertion order via Array iteration (used via spread).
No locked cards shown on completion screen (no PremiumGate or lock markup rendered inside OnboardingComplete).
Completion screen has NO onboarding-step-indicator and NO progressbar — confirmed via DOM query on both bartender and waiter flows.

Code grep /app/frontend/src: no '€', no '5.99', no '39.99', no 'certificate' in paywall benefits, no 'Restore' button (only a 'Restore Learn scroll position' comment and a code comment stating 'no restore').

success_rate.frontend: 100% of acceptance criteria pass; 1 minor i18n polish noted

test_credentials: Anonymous guests via localStorage iph_guest_id (fresh per flow). Created two guests during this run (bartender and waiter).
seed_data_creation: Two guest profiles completed onboarding (one bartender, one waiter) through API calls triggered by the real UI flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated with Playwright at 390x800. Bartender run slugs=[taking-a-drinks-order, guest-arrives-at-the-bar, recommending-drinks]; Waiter slugs=[guest-is-not-ready-to-order, welcoming-guests, bringing-the-bill]. All 3 accessible on /lesson/{slug} with no premium-account-gate and no lesson-locked. onboarding-start-learning-btn navigates to /home. Step indicator reads 'Step 1 of 6' (en) or 'Paso 6 de 6' (es) and disappears on the completion screen. Learn 25-situations-per-role / venue_type non-filtering already confirmed in iteration_24 — not re-run here because the specific free-rec validation was the only change under review.
rca of the issue: Previous iteration showed only 1 rec for free bartender because filtering was limited to the API-returned recommendations list (which had only 1 free-for-role item). Fix: after filter, top up with freeSlugs(profession, role) via getSituation calls until the list reaches 3. Verified working for both roles.
